does: Rolls on the roll manager's stream the caller names: finds it among the manager's streams, marks the manager changed, rolls through the weighted (Karmic Dice) path when weighted rolls are on and the stream's type is one it weights, else through RollDiceWithBoosts; answers the roll result.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll stream counts: both d20 draws of a fair melee attack return through +0x105B9ED of this function, called from RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (+0x106CE8B); it scans the manager's streams (0x78 bytes each, the layout the rolls executor confirmed) for the one asked; callers include eoc::stats::AbilityCheck (+0x10764A0) and the check against a DC at +0x1075BA0
